summary: CEA Industries Inc. and activist investor YZi Labs entered a cooperation agreement terminating YZi Labs' consent solicitation. YZi Labs holds 2,150,481 common shares and warrants for 21,215,860 additional shares. The board was expanded to six; YZi Labs appointed Ling Ella Zhang, Alex Odagiu, and Matthew Roszak as directors, with replacement rights while holding ≥4.99% stock. The board will add a mutually agreed independent director within 90 days. This settlement averts a proxy fight, with YZi Labs gaining board control. Watch for potential strategic or operational changes under new directors; risk-arb angle limited as no transaction price.
